## How it was tested

- [ ] Checked in game on Minecraft 1.21.1 with Fabric and with NeoForge (the test mod: `./gradlew :fabric:runClient`, `:neoforge:runClient`)
- [ ] Checked in both styles (rectangular and rounded), if the change is visible
- [ ] New or changed texts are added to both `en_us.json` and `ru_ru.json`
- [ ] The public API (`net.tapacywka.aacs.api`) only grows: nothing removed or changed incompatibly
